reviews.author: Ashis kumar Dash
reviews.text: It was a nice property with the lake view. & the food quality was also good 👍.  Must recommend place.

reviews.author: Anonym Review
reviews.text:
Wow! this place is surrounded by Mountains, Backwater, lake-view, table top, Sunrise-Sunset views, Greenery, peace-filled location. This is best place for family/group camping, star-gazing, nature-surfing! We can feel "Homely" hospitality by owners and family members. We have enjoyed tasty satvik home-made quality food. Very well cleanlyness has been maintained at Tents/Cottages/Toilets/Campsite. Thank you to Team 5 Billion Starts Camping for making our Camping trip a great success!

Rooms
Small Cottages and Tents are very-well maintained. Clean bedsheets and blankets provided.

Nearby activities
Forts, Hadsi temple, Lonavala tiger point etc.

Food & drinks
High quality, home-made, satvik, gavraan food. Neat and clean plates and tables.

Noteworthy details
Homely environment, Owner and family members are very polite in nature, We can get personal attention to our requests. Ample parking facililty available.

Hotel highlights
Great view, Romantic, Quiet, Great value

reviews.author: Ashish Bhati
reviews.text: “Beautiful lakeside location with breathtaking sunrise/sunset views and a calm, scenic atmosphere — tents are cozy and bonfires make the stay fun, though amenities can be basic.”

reviews.author: Yash Shinde
reviews.text: This property is Great. I travelled here with my office team and had a great time. The food is amazing and the stay experience is also very good. The USP of this property is the Pawana Dam view from top. Recommended to visit once.

reviews.author: sachin shedge
reviews.text: I went to this night camping location with my family, this was my first time experience with night camping. My whole family enjoyed a lot because of many things which surpassed my expectations. Like - location is very beautiful from where you can see backwater of PAVANA dam and TIKONA fort,  pleasant atmosphere where you can feel fresh natural air & hear sounds of singing birds. Less crowded place. Easy access for four wheelers and sufficient parking space. Staff is very cooperative and kind. Food was awesome, cleanliness of campus and washrooms are up to mark. Overall I will rate this destination as a 5star and surely recommend to friends and relatives.

reviews.author: Anirban Sinha
reviews.text:
Visited to celebrate new year with family. We had a group of 12 people with 3 kids. Our entire group have enjoyed the atmosphere, location, food. The veg barbeque was superb and veg food was also great. Non veg barbeque and food also good but they can improve on taste. Morning breakfast was simple but adequate.
We had our doubts in staying in tents with kids and elderly parents but we didn't faced any issues.
Only challange is they have only two common toilets which isn't adequate.If they improve on that they will definitely be a five star camping place.

reviews.author: Ashish Chakranarayan
reviews.text:
Great quiet and friendly campsite
This is a lovely quiet get away from it all campsite.
has all you need but with out the glitz and noise. It is tranquil and green with a wonderful view that you couldn't let go off easily. At the camp, The tents provided were clean, comfortable and airy and the washrooms maintained, also the food was homely and amazing. The evening bonfire around the camp was the best part and we had one of the best time there. Special mention needs to be made for the excellent hosts our heartiest thanks to Akshay, Nivrutti and their lovely family for the hospitality and for the service provided. The place is awesome and ideal short trip for friends and families alike.
Hope to visit again soon.!!!

reviews.author: Amogh Sail
reviews.text:
Location is good, but little bit tricky for access as we have to drive downhill to get to the location.
Ambiance was okay the place is still building.
Tents are good with ample place for kids to play.
Parking can be tricky if their are more cars.
Food was good, loved the chai. Bbq was good but we cannot make it on our own it is served to us.
Overall good experience.
